description: List the termination and cancellation actions FPDS records on the news publisher and wire families' and the information companies' contracts in the Media Money Register, optionally filtered by family (a substring of a family name), agency (a substring of the agency or department as FPDS prints it, or a short form such as DHS, DoD, HHS or State) and window (before: the 645 days to January 19, 2025; since: January 20, 2025 to the as-of date); at most 25 rows, the most recently signed at the top, with the full count and the counts by window. Each row gives the family, the agency and department, the award and modification numbers, the date signed, FPDS's reason code and its description as printed (F, terminate for convenience; N, legal contract cancellation; E, terminate for default; X, terminate for cause), the amount the action itself records, any initiative code as printed and the product code. Actions are unique by agency, award and modification; a termination of a prepaid subscription can record little or nothing, and the amount is never compared with any claim. Each figure is named in its record's own words: contract obligations (a subscription is a purchase order, delivery order or definitive contract), grant obligations by assistance listing, Treasury account obligations, termination actions with FPDS's reason code as printed, and the laws' own text; fiscal year 2026 is as reported through the as-of date, as Defense Department contract records reach USAspending about 90 days late. Every answer carries the register's question note: these records show federal award and account obligations and the agencies' own termination records; they do not show what any outlet published, why an award was made or ended, or whether any payment affected coverage. Every answer also carries the side-by-side caption, the as-of date, each file's date, the source page on morvs.ai and the licence. Institutions only: no official, consultant, journalist, treasurer or candidate is named; withheld recipients and the advertising firms whose name is a person's full name appear only as counts. No party label is given and no outlet's content is characterised.

agency.description: Optional agency or department name substring as FPDS prints it, or a short form such as DHS, DoD, HHS or State; at most 80 characters.

family.description: Optional case-insensitive substring of a news publisher, wire or information-company family name, for example Politico; at most 80 characters.

window.description: Optional window: before (the 645 days to January 19, 2025) or since (January 20, 2025 to the as-of date); both when omitted, never added.

name: media_money_terminations
title: List Media Contract Termination Actions
